sentences.text:
Ipsita Chakraborti
 Vs.
 Somnath Ray chowdhury & Ors.
The present revisional application of the year 2019 was last heard on 25.09.2019.

The present revision of the years 2019 has been preferred praying for further investigation regarding G.R. No. 4383 of 2016 arising out of Santragachi Police Station Case No. 57 of 2016 dated 05.07.2016 under Section 498A of the IPC.

entities.text: Santragachi Police Station Case No. 57 of 2016
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
As none appears for the petitioner on repeated calls, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected applications, if any, stand disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance and to proceed with the trial expeditiously, if not disposed of, in accordance with law.
(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
